variety_description: Released by IGKVV, Raipur in 2010 for the irrigated areas of Chattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh and Odisha. Medium maturity, semi-dwarf variety with long bold grain. Tolerant to gall midge biotypes 1 and 6 and leaf blast which are major concerns in these rice growing environments. Rainfed areas of medium to heavy soils of Chhattisgarh are also suitable for this variety. Widely used for making good quality “poha” and puffed rice.
